create_SawyerBinPickingEnvV2: create a SawyerBinPickingEnvV2 environment instance to simulate a Sawyer robot bin picking task
run_evaluate_state: run evaluate_state on the SawyerBinPickingEnvV2 environment with an observation and action to get reward and info
run_compute_reward: run compute_reward to calculate the pick-place reward given an action and observation in the bin picking task
run_reset_model: run reset_model to reset the Sawyer robot hand and object positions for a new bin picking episode
review_SawyerBinPickingEnvV2_init: review the SawyerBinPickingEnvV2 init method to understand hand bounds, object bounds, goal space, and observation spaces
